annotations.title: Search CVEs by concept, keyword or seed CVE

description:
Search the CVE corpus — one entry point, three retrieval modes picked from your arguments:

  - query=  a concept / technique / weakness (e.g. "SSO SAML assertion replay",
            "deserialization gadget chain", "server-side request forgery cloud metadata").
            By default it FUSES full-text keyword search AND semantic mechanism-search, so you
            don't have to guess whether your phrasing is lexical or conceptual. order='relevance'
            = keyword only; order='similarity' = semantic only; order='severity' = fuse then
            rank P1>P4.
  - cve_id= a seed CVE (e.g. "CVE-2021-44228") -> its mechanism-siblings across OTHER products
            (the "what else looks like this?" move).
  - days= and/or product= (with NO query) -> the recent high-risk window (KEV / P1-P2 /
            high-EPSS); product= is CPE-name-resolved and each hit carries match.products.
            "Recent" = published in the window OR added to CISA KEV in it (an old CVE newly
            confirmed exploited counts); each hit says which (in_window / kev_added).
  A recency phrase inside query ("this week", "in the last 30 days", "today") is read as days=;
  `interpreted_as` says how the query was read.

Returns ranked cards (each with priority/KEV/EPSS/CWE) + total_matches for coverage; the
'mode' field reports which retrieval ran. You decide which matches matter.
(For one product's version-resolved vulns use check_technology, for a whole stack hunt_plan; for how bugs like this were
FOUND in disclosed reports use find_attack_approaches.)

Args:
    query: free-text concept / keyword / CWE.
    cve_id: seed CVE for semantic mechanism-sibling search.
    cwe: optional weakness filter, e.g. "CWE-502" or "502".
    days: window in days: published OR added to CISA KEV within it.
    product: product filter for the recent-window mode (CPE-name-resolved, carries provenance).
    order: relevance | similarity | severity (default: fused when query is text).
    limit: max results (default 20).
name: search_vulns
title: Search CVEs by concept, keyword or seed CVE
